max_clause.text: The Model Spec is just one part of our broader strategy for building and deploying AI responsibly. It is complemented by our [usage policies](https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies), which outline our expectations for how people should use the API and ChatGPT, as well as our [safety protocols](https://openai.com/index/our-approach-to-ai-safety/), which include testing, monitoring, and mitigating potential safety issues.

passage.quote: The Model Spec is just one part of our broader strategy for building and deploying AI responsibly.
